Name: Seasonal Construction
Author: EtaMyosotis
Description:
[size=3]I've always felt that the orange fencing and flooring in the construction area didn't go well with my game, so I made this.

The style references [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4542]Medieval buildings[/url]. There are seasons. But it's not perfect...not what I expected. I was going to put some flower petals and fallen leaves on the floor as well, and snow in the winter. But the flooring doesn't seem to be spliced very regularly, which would lead to some visual errors... so I gave up.

I found no errors in my testing. If you find any problems, please report them to me![/size]
